integrity: The proof is parameter-uniform. All finite checks and reproducibility programs are supplied in full; numerical verification is not represented as a proof of the infinite theorem.
limitations: Unordered multisets, exactly three surviving symbols, and q>=2, n>=q+2 only; the necessary high-multiplicity structure is not a complete classification of equality codes. An unindexed earlier proof is possible.
title: Exact three-survivor multiset deletion codes over arbitrary alphabets
